diagrams.topology: fermion box with the Delta_1 vertex (external ghost at Delta), omega A A A
diagrams.fields: closed Psi_f loop (sterile component next to Delta), f in {Q,U,D,L,E} with non-zero Tr_f(Tg^a Tg^b Tg^c Tg^d); vertices Delta_1[omega^a Psibar_f Psi_f] and three Psibar_f Psi_f A vertices
diagrams.multiplicity_note: 6 diagrams per multiplet: the 3! orderings sigma of the gauge legs along the fermion flow (Delta fixed; both orientations included). Labelled counts agree with ENUMERATION.md for all 13 gauge contents: cGGGG/cGGGB/cGGBB/cBGGG/cBGGB 18 (Q,U,D x 6), cGGWW/cWGGW 6 (Q), cWWWW/cWWWB/cWWBB/cBWWW/cBWWB 12 (Q,L), cBBBB 30 (5 x 6). Contents with a single SU(3) or SU(2) generator (e.g. cGGGW, cGWWB, cWBBB) vanish by tracelessness and are absent from both lists.

diagrams.topology: fermion pentagon with the Delta_1 vertex (external ghost at Delta), omega A A A A
diagrams.fields: closed Psi_f loop, Delta_1 vertex and four Psibar_f Psi_f A vertices
diagrams.multiplicity_note: 24 orderings per multiplet; agrees with ENUMERATION.md (cGGGGG 72 = 3 x 24, cWWWWW 48 = 2 x 24, cBBBBB 120 = 5 x 24, mixed contents likewise). Each diagram vanishes separately (N0 = N1 = 0).

pole_vertex_function.coefficient: 0 (every diagram has N_0 = 0 with d-dimensional external momenta; no evanescent pole either)

finite_breaking_vertex_function.structure: sum_f sum_(sigma in S_3) Tr_f (Tg^a Tg^(b_(sigma 1)) Tg^(b_(sigma 2)) Tg^(b_(sigma 3))) [q^(mu_(sigma 1)) g^(mu_(sigma 2) mu_(sigma 3)) - q^(mu_(sigma 2)) g^(mu_(sigma 1) mu_(sigma 3)) + q^(mu_(sigma 3)) g^(mu_(sigma 1) mu_(sigma 2))]   with (b_1,b_2,b_3) = (b,c,d), (mu_1,mu_2,mu_3) = (mu,nu,rho)
sum_(sigma in S_3) (sum_R - sum_L) Tr_f (Tg^a Tg^(b_(sigma 1)) Tg^(b_(sigma 2)) Tg^(b_(sigma 3))) epsilon^(q mu_(sigma 1) mu_(sigma 2) mu_(sigma 3))
finite_breaking_vertex_function.coefficient: 1/3  (this is the vertex function of the local functional (1/12) lf integral epsilon^(lambda mu nu rho) partial_lambda gh^a A^b_mu A^c_nu A^d_rho fg^(c d e) D^(a b e), verified numerically with anomalous content; zero for the SM since D^(abc) = 0)

per_topology.box: For one multiplet f and the ordering (b,mu,p_1),(c,nu,p_2),(d,rho,p_3) along the loop (group factor Tr_f(Tg^a Tg^b Tg^c Tg^d)), P N_1 = (i/3)(q^mu gmb^(nu rho) - q^nu gmb^(mu rho) + q^rho gmb^(mu nu)) + s_f (1/3) epsilon^(q mu nu rho), s_f = +1 (c_f = R), -1 (c_f = L), q = -(p_1+p_2+p_3); N_0 = 0 with d-dimensional externals. The function depends on the external momenta only through the ghost momentum q: X vanishes at q = 0 (all-order statement below). Hand: N_1 = (i/6) Tr_f(...) tr[qbar-slash gbar^mu gbar^nu gbar^rho P_c].

per_topology.pentagon: omega(G) = 0, T^(0) puts every external momentum, hence q, to zero; P_c S(k) V_Delta(k,k) S(k) P_cbar = 0 identically (V_Delta(k,k) = khat-slash (P_cbar - P_c)), so the T^(0) integrand of each of the 24 orderings vanishes before integration: N_0 = N_1 = 0 per diagram.

checks: Deriver (hand) and checker (bmhvkit, independent) agree coefficient by coefficient: per-ordering N_0 = 0 and P N_1 = (i/3)(q^mu g^{nu rho} - q^nu g^{mu rho} + q^rho g^{mu nu}) + (s_f/3) eps^{q mu nu rho}; operator form; all 21 non-zero N-basis coefficients and per-multiplet values; omega AAAA = 0.

Referee re-derivation by hand: chain identity, N_ch, T^(1) at p_j = 0, khat^2 kbar kbar -> -2 eta (k^2)^2 gbar/(d(d+2)), overall factor -i(-1)(-2eta)(-2)/24 = i eta/6, trace with P_c = (1+s_f g5)/2; q=0 Dirac identity; delta_chi sign of the all-order statement.
Referee analytic re-derivation of the SM table from d_4 (sym. SU(3)/SU(2) trace = (dd+dd+dd)/24 per triplet/doublet), S_f, and the SU(2) identity (d w^I.W^J)(W^I.W^J) = N_W4a - g^2 N_ff^(W).
Referee numeric check (eps_map.py, 3 random points, 1e-15): eps part per multiplet = sum_r D_f^(r)/12 (N_erBf - N_e4B) + D_f^(GGG)/24 N_edf.
Diagram list = ENUMERATION.md for every gauge content (checker; referee spot-checked counts 18/6/12/30 boxes, 72/24/48 pentagons).
Pole consistency: g0_VVV / g0_VVVV final fermion counterterms are -2/3 sum S_f times barred Q_3f and Q_YM (barred YM action, b_d-closed); bosonic poles b_d-closed; E_A feeds only omega A, omega AA.
Literature: parity-even part equals (1/6) int omega^a d_nu(A^b_mu A^c mu A^d nu) Acal^{abcd} of the targets file (BIMS) exactly; eps part prop. to D; omega AAAA = 0 as expected.
caveats: N_(epsilon d f) (SU(3)^3 anomaly structure in cVVV) is missing from tab:Nbasis; coefficient zero in the SM.
tab:Nbasis notation: in N_(G G G B 2) the ghost gh^B is the hypercharge ghost (index clash with SU(3) index B).
Parity-even part is b-exact in the quartic sector (b Y_4 with Y_4 = -1/3 sum_f int [1/2 Tr(A.A A.A) - 1/4 Tr(A_m A_n A^m A^n)]); the full solution needs g1_cVV (Q_3f, Q_3d, Q_B2 contribute here).
All-order statement assumes S_ren - S_0 contains no sterile component; it concerns only the Delta_1 insertion.
